Bill.BriefDescription: Providing limited immunity for firefighters providing emergency services.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to immunity from liability for civil damages forfirefighters; and adding a new section to chapter 4.24 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 4.24 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Any state or municipal firefighter, whether volunteer or paid, whotakes part in firefighting efforts outside his or her jurisdiction orprovides emergency care, rescue, assistance, or recovery services atthe scene of an emergency is not liable for civil damages resultingfrom any act or omission in the rendering of such services, other thanacts or omissions constituting gross negligence or willful or wantonmisconduct.
